headline: Titans treat the Goons like a bye week with extra steps
dek: Turf Titans 149.6, Gridiron Goons 107.5. End Zone Enforcers drew the actual bye and still somehow look busier.
body: Dynasty week 14 had one real game and it was not close enough to narrate twice: Titans 149.6 over Goons 107.5. Enforcers sat this one out, which is the correct use of a bye if your season is already a group project.
Three-team leagues make every result feel personal. This one was.

ranking_copy.blurb: Turf Titans, 5-2 on the H2H card after a 149-piece. If this were a bigger league they would still be annoying.
Gridiron Goons at 7-7 with 1,644 PF — lots of points, not enough of them on Tuesday.
End Zone Enforcers: bye. 2-5. The ranking is a participation ribbon and also a warning.
